# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Brother, Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians aren't a suggestion; they are a battle order. He lists four imperatives: Watch, Stand Fast, Be Brave, Be Strong. Notice the order. You cannot be strong if you are not watching. You cannot be brave if you have not first stood your ground in the faith. The enemy doesn't fear your muscles; he fears your vigilance. He prowls not when you are fighting, but when you are scrolling, complacent, and distracted. Your strength is not just physical; it's the resolve to hold your position when the world tells you to retreat. Today, you are called to be a guardian—of your heart, your home, and your testimony. Don't wait for the battle to find you; stand ready in the gap before it arrives. Your courage is a byproduct of your conviction. Check your watch, lock your shield, and hold the line.

## Daily Challenge
Before your workout, spend 2 minutes in silence, asking God to reveal one area where you've been complacent. Then, do 30 pushups, praying for strength to hold your position today.
